lines.text: Twelve army divisions of 24,000 men each served the king, one division for each month of the year.
Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest commanded the division for the third month and was over the Thirty.
Over the tribes, Zadok was over Aaron, and Elihu, one of David's uncles, was over Judah.
David did not count men aged twenty or under, and Joab finished the census, so wrath came upon Israel.

wrong_details.true: began to count the men but did not finish

lines.text: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels, and Hushai the Archite was the king's friend.
